subject: Promo credits & billing alignment for GrowthHub Labs
messages:
From: Ava Thompson <ava@growthhub.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, Sep 30 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Promo credits for GrowthHub pilot?

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the product walkthrough yesterday — the latency profile looked great for our live demo next month. Quick ask from our side: GrowthHub runs a 12-week accelerator cohort and we try to centralize vendor credits for the startups that join. Is there a startup/accelerator promo you can extend for 3–4 high-potential teams in our Fall cohort?

High-level asks: 1) a one-time pool of credits the cohort can draw from (we can manage allocation), 2) a 20% price-protection window for 6 months after the cohort starts, and 3) a brief MAP/commit that lets us show the program to our sponsors.

We’re not looking for free unlimited usage — just enough runway so teams can iterate during the program (roughly 3 months). Happy to share cohort details and the sponsor contact if useful.

Appreciate any flexibility — we typically highlight vendor partners in our program materials.

Best,
Ava Thompson
Partnerships, GrowthHub Labs
[Attachment: cohort_one_pulse.pdf]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Thompson <ava@growthhub.io>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Oct 01 2026 09:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credits for GrowthHub pilot?

Hi Ava — great meeting yesterday, thanks for the context.

We’d love to partner with GrowthHub on the cohort. Initial, standard option we typically offer for accelerators:
- 60,000 token credit pool for the cohort (usable across up to 5 teams)
- 20% promo pricing applied to first 6 months after cohort start (applies to tokens beyond the credit pool)
- MAP (mutual action plan) and partner badge once the MAP is signed

I’ve attached a short MAP template and the promo terms we use for similar programs. If you need a larger pool or longer protection, we can look at a tiered approach tied to sponsor introductions or a small committed spend.

Next steps: if that aligns, sign the MAP and procurement can route a PO to finalize the credits. If you want a larger pool, tell me the target amount and the sponsor/commitment structure — I’ll loop in finance for an exception.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: GrowthHub-MAP.xlsx] [Attachment: Promo-Terms.pdf]

From: Ava Thompson <ava@growthhub.io>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: GrowthHub Labs Procurement <procurement@growthhub.io>
Date: Fri, Oct 02 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credits for GrowthHub pilot?

Thanks Soojin — that’s a helpful starting point. Couple of follow-ups from our side:
1) Our program director is asking if you can increase the credit pool to 150,000 tokens. We have 4 teams that will be heavier on embeddings and retrieval (higher token use).
2) Sponsor ask: if we can get a 9-month price-protection window instead of 6, there’s a strong chance our sponsor will list Redwood as a preferred partner (we’ll commit an intro to the sponsor).
3) Procurement will need a PO and your standard reseller/terms.

Are those two items (bump to 150k and 9-month protection) something you can approve, or do we need to structure this as a paid promo with a small one-time sponsor fee?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — cohort starts Oct 18 and we want partners locked in this week.

— Ava
Procurement cc: "GrowthHub Labs Procurement"

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, Oct 02 2026 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: GrowthHub promo request — internal

Looping internal context here so we can reply with an approved offer. Quick notes:
- Our standard accelerator package (60k + 6mo protection) is pre-approved.
- We can stretch to 100k tokens and 8 months price-protection as a comp-level manager exception if GrowthHub provides the sponsor intro and an LOI from the cohort organizer. That avoids touching finance approvals.
- Anything beyond 100k or a full 9-month protection needs Rishi’s approval (quota/credit exposure) and likely a short legal amendment to the promo terms.

If GrowthHub presses for 150k, ask for a small paid component (e.g., $2,500 sponsor fee) or a written sponsor commitment to unlock the extra 50k. That preserves our unit economics while keeping the partnership attractive.

I’ll be available for a five-minute call if you want to run language.

— Monica
Director, Growth Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Thompson <ava@growthhub.io>
Cc: GrowthHub Labs Procurement <procurement@growthhub.io>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, Oct 05 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Revised offer: GrowthHub cohort promo (conditional)

Hi Ava — thanks for the details and the timeline. We can be flexible given the sponsor upside. Here’s a revised, conditional offer: 
- 100,000 token credit pool (usable across up to 6 teams)
- 8 months price-protection from cohort start
- To unlock an additional 50,000 tokens (to reach 150k) and extend to 9 months we request either: 1) a sponsor intro + LOI, or 2) a one-time sponsor fee of $2,500 payable by GrowthHub.

If GrowthHub signs the attached MAP and confirms the sponsor commitment (or sponsor fee), we’ll issue the credits and provide the partner badge. Procurement: please send a PO referencing deal GH-2026-0911; we’ll route the promo amendment for signature and add the credit pool once PO is received.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on the cohort.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: GrowthHub-MAP.xlsx]
